##What should we be rounding the CO2 and CH4 to? Any decimal places? 
##Removes samples that are 10x the annual plot mean (unusually high)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

##Grab All Data Files
```{r Pull in 2021-2025 data files, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#read in 2023 SGAS Data:
dat21 <- read.csv("TEMPEST_SGW_2021_Data/COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2021.csv", colClasses = "character")
# head(dat21)
colnames(dat21)
dat21_formatted <- dat21 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Collection_Date)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Year = substr(Collection_Date, 1, 4), 
         Sample_Month = substr(Collection_Date, 6, 7), 
         Sample_Day = substr(Collection_Date, 9, 10), 
         G_W = "G") ##Assumed all 2021 samples were gas samples, not gas from water

#read in 2023 SGAS Data:
dat22 <- read.csv("TEMPEST_SGW_2022_Data/COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2022.csv", colClasses = "character")
# head(dat22)
colnames(dat22)
dat22_formatted <- dat22 %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Year = substr(Collection_Date, 1, 4), 
         Sample_Month = substr(Collection_Date, 5, 6), 
         Sample_Day = substr(Collection_Date, 7, 8)) %>% 
  rename(CH4_ppm = CH4_Conc_ppm, 
         CO2_ppm = CO2_Conc_ppm, 
         CH4_uM = CH4_Conc_umol, 
         CO2_uM = CO2_Conc_umol, 
         Event_Stamp = Timepoint, 
         G_W = Sample_Type)

#read in 2023 SGAS Data:
dat23 <- read.csv("TEMPEST_SGW_2023_Data/COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2023.csv", colClasses = "character")
# head(dat23)
colnames(dat23)
dat23_formatted <- dat23 %>% 
  rename(CH4_uM = CH4_Conc_umol, 
         CO2_uM = CO2_Conc_umol, 
         CH4_ppm = CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, 
         CO2_ppm = CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr) %>% 
  mutate(CH4_uM = ifelse(G_W == "G", NA, CH4_uM), 
         CO2_uM = ifelse(G_W == "G", NA, CO2_uM), 
         Sample_Month = as.character(match(Sample_Month, month.name)), 
         Depth = Sample_Depth)

#read in 2024 SGAS Data:
dat24 <- read.csv("TEMPEST_SGW_2024_Data/COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2024.csv", colClasses = "character")
# head(dat24)
colnames(dat24)
dat24_formatted <- dat24 %>% 
  rename(CH4_uM = CH4_Conc_umol, 
         CO2_uM = CO2_Conc_umol, 
         CH4_ppm = CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, 
         CO2_ppm = CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr) %>% 
  mutate(CH4_uM = ifelse(G_W == "G", NA, CH4_uM), 
         CO2_uM = ifelse(G_W == "G", NA, CO2_uM), 
         Sample_Month = as.character(match(Sample_Month, month.name)), 
         Depth = Sample_Depth)

#read in 2024 SGAS Data:
dat25 <- read.csv("TEMPEST_SGW_2025_Data/COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2025.csv", colClasses = "character")
# head(dat25)
colnames(dat25)
dat25_formatted <- dat25 %>% 
  rename(CH4_uM = CH4_Conc_uM, 
         CO2_uM = CO2_Conc_uM, 
         N2O_uM = N2O_Conc_uM, 
         CH4_ppm = CH4_Conc_ppm, 
         CO2_ppm = CO2_Conc_ppm, 
         N2O_ppm = N2O_Conc_ppm) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Month = as.character(match(Sample_Month, month.name)), 
         Depth = Sample_Depth)


all_dat <- bind_rows(dat21_formatted, dat22_formatted, dat23_formatted, dat24_formatted, dat25_formatted)

colnames(all_dat)

##Clean data
final_data <- all_dat %>% 
  filter(is.na(qaqc_flag)) %>% #Remove samples flagged for unusually high values 
  filter(Sample_Plot != "Transition") %>% ##Remove GCW TR samples
  mutate(Sample_Plot = ifelse(Sample_Plot == "Seawater", "Saltwater", Sample_Plot)) %>% ##SW plot name changed
  mutate(Sample_Plot = case_when(
    Sample_Plot == "C" ~ "Control", 
    Sample_Plot == "FW" ~ "Freshwater", 
    Sample_Plot == "SW" ~ "Saltwater", 
    TRUE ~ Sample_Plot)) %>% 
  mutate(Depth = ifelse(Depth == "ATM", "0", Depth)) %>% ##SW plot name changed
  ##Rename columns
  rename(Analysis_rundate = Run_Date, 
         Lab_Notes = Notes, 
         Year = Sample_Year, 
         Month = Sample_Month, 
         Day = Sample_Day, 
         Time = Sample_Time, 
         Grid_Square = Sample_Grid, 
         Plot = Sample_Plot, 
         Sample_Matrix = G_W, 
         Time_Local = Sample_Time) %>% 
  ##Add extra info
  mutate(Project = "COMPASS", 
         Site = "TEMPEST") %>% 
  ##Select only required columns
  select(c(Project, Site, Year, Month, Day, Time_Local, Event_Stamp, Plot, Grid_Square, Depth, Sample_Matrix, Dilution_Factor, 
           CH4_uM, CH4_ppm, CH4_Flag, CO2_ppm, CO2_uM, CO2_Flag, N2O_ppm, N2O_uM, N2O_Conc_Flag, Field_Notes, Lab_Notes, QAQC_Flags)) %>% 
  ##Round data
  mutate(across(c(CH4_uM, CH4_ppm, CO2_ppm, CO2_uM, N2O_ppm, N2O_uM), ~as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, digits = 2)) #Can change this depending on what the machine output is  

```

##Write out files
```{r write out combined data and metadata, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
write.csv(final_data, "COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_AllData.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Visualize Data by Plot   
```{r Visualize Data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=20, fig.height=10, dpi = 300}

data_plotting <- final_data %>% 
  mutate(plot_1 = factor(Plot, levels = c("Control", "Freshwater", "Saltwater")))

#Plot data and change colors based on Zone:
viz_ch4_plot <- ggplot(data_plotting, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = CH4_ppm, fill = plot_1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2(preserve = "total")) +
  facet_wrap( ~ plot_1, scales="free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "springgreen2",
    "Freshwater" = "cyan2",
    "Saltwater" = "violetred2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = " ", y = "CH4 (ppm)", title = "Samples: CH4") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(.05, "lines"), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 28))

# viz_ch4_plot


viz_co2_plot <-  ggplot(data_plotting, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = CO2_ppm, fill = plot_1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2(preserve = "total")) +
  facet_wrap( ~ plot_1, scales="free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "springgreen2",
    "Freshwater" = "cyan2",
    "Saltwater" = "violetred2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = " ", y = "CO2 (ppm)", title = "Samples: CO2") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(.05, "lines"), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1))+ 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 28))

# viz_co2_plot

ggarrange(viz_ch4_plot, viz_co2_plot, nrow=2, ncol=1)


```


## Summarized data for Site and Zone 
```{r Summarize and Visualize Data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=22, fig.height=15, dpi = 300}

##Make Date Column
data_plotting$Date <- as.Date(paste(data_plotting$Year, data_plotting$Month, data_plotting$Day, sep = "-"))

##Summarize SGAS by Date, Site, and Zone
SGAS_avg <- data_plotting %>%
  group_by(Date, plot_1) %>%
   dplyr::summarize(mean_ch4 = mean(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            sd_ch4 = sd(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            mean_co2 = mean(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            sd_co2 = sd(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE))

# Define the specific date breaks you want to display
# specific_breaks <- as.Date(c("2023-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2025-01-01"))

viz_ch4_plot_avgs <- ggplot(SGAS_avg, aes(x = Date, y = mean_ch4, color = plot_1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_ch4 - sd_ch4, ymax = mean_ch4 + sd_ch4), width = 0.2) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap( ~ plot_1, scales="free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "springgreen2",
    "Freshwater" = "cyan2",
    "Saltwater" = "violetred2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = " ", y = "CH4 (ppm)", title = "Samples: CH4") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)) +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5))+ 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 28))+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.18, 0.05)))+
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 1))+
  theme(axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0.25, "cm")) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1))+ 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# viz_ch4_plot_avgs


viz_co2_plot_avgs <- ggplot(SGAS_avg, aes(x = Date, y = mean_co2, color = plot_1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_co2 - sd_co2, ymax = mean_co2 + sd_co2), width = 0.2) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap( ~ plot_1, scales="free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "springgreen2",
    "Freshwater" = "cyan2",
    "Saltwater" = "violetred2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = " ", y = "CO2 (ppm)", title = "Samples: CO2") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)) +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5))+ 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 28))+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.18, 0.05)))+
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 1))+
  theme(axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0.25, "cm")) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+ 
  theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20))

# viz_co2_plot_avgs

ggarrange(viz_ch4_plot_avgs, viz_co2_plot_avgs, nrow=2, ncol=1)

```


## Summarized Data by Depth
```{r Summarize Data by Depth, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=22, fig.height=8, dpi = 500}

##Remove SW and calculate average and sd for each depth
SGAS_avg_depth <- data_plotting %>%
  group_by(plot_1, Depth, Year) %>%
   dplyr::summarize(mean_ch4 = mean(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            sd_ch4 = sd(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            mean_co2 = mean(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
            sd_co2 = sd(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE))

viz_ch4_plot_depth <- ggplot(SGAS_avg_depth, aes(x = as.numeric(Depth), y = mean_ch4, color = plot_1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_ch4 - sd_ch4, ymax = mean_ch4 + sd_ch4), width = 0.5, size = 1) +

  facet_wrap( ~ Year, scales="free", nrow = 1) +

    "Control" = "springgreen2",

  )) +
  theme_classic() +
```

##Calculate summary metrics
```{r Additional summary metrics, include=FALSE, dpi = 300}
# It would also be great to add to our collation codes a summary chunk that will calculate value ranges, means, and standard deviations (and errors) for each site, zone, depth for each year; also for each site zone, depth overall; and for each site and zone overall so that we have some easy access to metrics. Was just thinking this might be helpful today when re-collating the DIC data.

colnames(final_data)

##Metrics for each site, zone, depth for each year
summary_by_year <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Year, Plot, Depth) %>%
   reframe(
     min_CH4_ppm = min(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CH4_ppm = max(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CH4_ppm = mean(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CH4_ppm = sd(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 

     min_CO2_ppm = min(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CO2_ppm = max(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CO2_ppm = mean(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CO2_ppm = sd(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, digits = 0)) 

##Metrics for each site, zone, depth for all years
summary_all_years <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Plot, Depth) %>%
   reframe(
     min_CH4_ppm = min(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CH4_ppm = max(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CH4_ppm = mean(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CH4_ppm = sd(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 

     min_CO2_ppm = min(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CO2_ppm = max(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CO2_ppm = mean(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CO2_ppm = sd(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, digits = 0)) 

##Metrics for each site and zone for all depths and years
summary_all_depths_years <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
    reframe(
     min_CH4_ppm = min(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CH4_ppm = max(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CH4_ppm = mean(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CH4_ppm = sd(CH4_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 

     min_CO2_ppm = min(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE),
     max_CO2_ppm = max(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     mean_CO2_ppm = mean(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE), 
     sd_CO2_ppm = sd(CO2_ppm, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, digits = 0)) 

```

##Calculate number of samples 
```{r Number of samples, include=FALSE, dpi = 300}
#  I am thinking it might be cool to add to our Soil Gas Well collation files a table at the end that has total number of samples then also some info about # of samples per zone, site, depth etc.

##Metrics for each year
sample_numbers_years <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
   reframe(
     Number_of_samples = n())

##Metrics for each site, zone, depth for all years
sample_numbers <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Plot, Depth) %>%
   reframe(
     Number_of_samples = n())
     

```

## Summary Tables
```{r Summary table metrics, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, dpi = 100}

kable(
  summary_all_depths_years[, c("Plot", "min_CH4_ppm",	"max_CH4_ppm",	"mean_CH4_ppm", "min_CO2_ppm",	"max_CO2_ppm",	"mean_CO2_ppm")],  
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = "Summary Statistics"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped", "scale_down"),
    font_size = 12
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%   # header
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)


```

```{r number of samples tables, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, dpi = 100}
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
```
